zh.title: 更新日志访问优化
zh.summary: 版本检查与更新日志改用独立托管，减少对 GitHub 访问的依赖。

items.text: 关于页通过 Netlify 获取版本信息和完整中英文更新日志，不再依赖 GitHub Raw。
完整系列日志合并为一次请求，加载失败可重试，并保留历史版本快照。

en.title: More accessible update notes
en.summary: Version checks and release notes now use independent hosting instead of GitHub Raw.

items.text: About now retrieves version information and complete bilingual release notes from Netlify without GitHub Raw requests.
Loads the complete release series in one notes request, supports retries after failures, and preserves historical snapshots.
